name: a3x1-echarts-build
description: Build a slimmed ECharts bundle for web/vendor/echarts.slim.js

scripts.build: esbuild entry.js --bundle --minify --format=iife --target=es2017 --legal-comments=none --banner:js="/*! ECharts custom build: line+candlestick+bar + grid/tooltip/markLine/axisPointer/legend/title + canvas. Apache-2.0. */" --outfile=../../web/vendor/echarts.slim.js
